component.name: Plasma Theme Studio
component.summary: Edit every part of a KDE Plasma theme in one place
Redigera alla delar av ett KDE Plasma-tema på ett ställe

description.p: Plasma Theme Studio keeps a whole KDE Plasma desktop theme in one file, shows it in a visual preview, and applies it to the running desktop. Every part of the desktop has its own page with preview cards, like System Settings, so you see what you change before you change it.

Plasma Theme Studio samlar ett helt KDE Plasma-tema i en fil, visar det i en förhandsvisning och verkställer det på det skrivbord som körs. Varje del av skrivbordet har en egen sida med förhandsvisningskort, som i Systeminställningar.

ul.li: Colors, with accent colors, light and dark variants and a contrast check
Application style (Kvantum), GTK applications and Rofi
Plasma style, panels and popups, with a frame editor for your own artwork
Window decorations, shadows and title bar buttons
Fonts, icons, pointers, the splash screen and system sounds

description.p: Every apply takes a snapshot first, so it can be undone exactly, from the app or from a text console. The app only writes inside your home folder and shows the exact files it is about to write. Themes can be exported as one shareable archive or as a Global Theme.
Varje verkställning tar först en ögonblicksbild, så att den kan ångras exakt, från appen eller från en textkonsol. Appen skriver bara i din hemkatalog och visar vilka filer den ska skriva.

screenshot.caption: The editor with a dark theme open

description.p: First release: a whole desktop theme in one file, edited with a visual preview.

ul.li: One page for each part of the desktop, with preview cards
Colors, application style, GTK, Plasma style, panels, window decorations, fonts, icons, pointers, splash screen, system sounds and Rofi
Apply with a snapshot and an exact undo, in the app and on the command line
